name: Kinshicho
tagline: Tokyo in 9 minutes and Otemachi in 14 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Sumida City, served by JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local), JR Sobu Main Line and Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 14 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 33 minutes to Shibuya and 23 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 5.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 6.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 5.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -0.5 m to 5.5 m, a difference of 6.0 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 8 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 8 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 19 clinics and 11 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 都立墨東病院, about 461 m away and 賛育会病院, about 616 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station: JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local), JR Sobu Main Line and Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 2 lines and Tokyo Metro runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 73.

rentRange.note: One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000, 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000, 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.note: 895 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Kinshicho.
1095 m away in a straight line. It takes 7 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Kinshicho. One-room rents run about ¥13,000 lower.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want another route when a line stops
People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
